I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned experiencing rectal bleeding and a palpable rectal mass; to begin my assessment, have you noticed any changes in your bowel habits, such as narrowing stools or a feeling of incomplete evacuation?

Also, please estimate the duration of these symptoms and describe the color and consistency of the blood you are seeing.

speaker: Patient
text: 45-year-old female. The patient reports a 2-week history of rectal bleeding occurring daily with bowel movements. She denies any pain with defecation and does not present with any other complaints.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Rectal Cancer

Based on your age, the presence of a palpable rectal mass, and daily rectal bleeding over two weeks without pain, I am concerned about malignancy. Have you noticed any unintended weight loss, fatigue, or nighttime bleeding? REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count, Comprehensive Metabolic Panel, CEA Tumor Marker. REQUEST IMAGES: Pelvic MRI with Rectal Protocol.
